1671final class PropertiesParser {
1672
1673        private PropertiesParser() {
1674        }
1675
1676        static Map<String, String> readProperties(String input) {
1677                Map<String, String> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
1678                StringReader sr = new StringReader(input);
1679                try {
1680                        readProperties(sr, m::put);
1681                }
1682                catch (IOException e) {
1683                        throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
1684                }
1685                return m;
1686        }
1687
1688        static void readProperties(Reader reader, BiConsumer<String, String> consumer) throws IOException {
1689                Properties bp = prepareProperties(consumer);
1690                bp.load(reader);
1691        }
1692
1693        private static Properties prepareProperties(BiConsumer<String, String> consumer) {
1694                // Hack to use properties class to load but our map for preserved order
1695                @SuppressWarnings({ "serial", "nullness" })
1696                Properties bp = new Properties() {
1697                        @Override
1698                        @SuppressWarnings({ "nullness", "keyfor", "UnsynchronizedOverridesSynchronized" }) // checker
1699                                                                                                                                                                                                // bug
1700                        public @Nullable Object put(Object key, Object value) {
1701                                Objects.requireNonNull(key);
1702                                Objects.requireNonNull(value);
1703                                consumer.accept((String) key, (String) value);
1704                                return null;
1705                        }
1706                };
1707                return bp;
1708        }
1709
1710}

1712final class PercentCodec {
1713
1714        static final BitSet GEN_DELIMS = new BitSet(256);
1715        static final BitSet SUB_DELIMS = new BitSet(256);
1716        static final BitSet UNRESERVED = new BitSet(256);
1717        static final BitSet URIC = new BitSet(256);
1718
1719        static {
1720                GEN_DELIMS.set(':');
1721                GEN_DELIMS.set('/');
1722                GEN_DELIMS.set('?');
1723                GEN_DELIMS.set('#');
1724                GEN_DELIMS.set('[');
1725                GEN_DELIMS.set(']');
1726                GEN_DELIMS.set('@');
1727
1728                SUB_DELIMS.set('!');
1729                SUB_DELIMS.set('$');
1730                SUB_DELIMS.set('&');
1731                SUB_DELIMS.set('\'');
1732                SUB_DELIMS.set('(');
1733                SUB_DELIMS.set(')');
1734                SUB_DELIMS.set('*');
1735                SUB_DELIMS.set('+');
1736                SUB_DELIMS.set(',');
1737                SUB_DELIMS.set(';');
1738                SUB_DELIMS.set('=');
1739
1740                for (int i = 'a'; i <= 'z'; i++) {
1741                        UNRESERVED.set(i);
1742                }
1743                for (int i = 'A'; i <= 'Z'; i++) {
1744                        UNRESERVED.set(i);
1745                }
1746                // numeric characters
1747                for (int i = '0'; i <= '9'; i++) {
1748                        UNRESERVED.set(i);
1749                }
1750                UNRESERVED.set('-');
1751                UNRESERVED.set('.');
1752                UNRESERVED.set('_');
1753                UNRESERVED.set('~');
1754                URIC.or(SUB_DELIMS);
1755                URIC.or(UNRESERVED);
1756        }
1757
1758        private static final int RADIX = 16;
1759
1760        static void encode(final StringBuilder buf, final CharSequence content, Charset charset, final BitSet safechars) {
1761                final CharBuffer cb = CharBuffer.wrap(content);
1762                final ByteBuffer bb = charset.encode(cb);
1763                while (bb.hasRemaining()) {
1764                        final int b = bb.get() & 0xff;
1765                        if (safechars.get(b)) {
1766                                buf.append((char) b);
1767                        }
1768                        else {
1769                                buf.append("%");
1770                                final char hex1 = Character.toUpperCase(Character.forDigit((b >> 4) & 0xF, RADIX));
1771                                final char hex2 = Character.toUpperCase(Character.forDigit(b & 0xF, RADIX));
1772                                buf.append(hex1);
1773                                buf.append(hex2);
1774                        }
1775                }
1776        }
1777
1778        public static void encode(final StringBuilder buf, final CharSequence content, final Charset charset) {
1779                encode(buf, content, charset, UNRESERVED);
1780        }
1781
1782        public static String encode(final CharSequence content, final Charset charset) {
1783                final StringBuilder buf = new StringBuilder();
1784                encode(buf, content, charset);
1785                return buf.toString();
1786        }
1787
1788        public static String decode(final CharSequence content, Charset charset) {
1789                final ByteBuffer bb = ByteBuffer.allocate(content.length());
1790                final CharBuffer cb = CharBuffer.wrap(content);
1791                while (cb.hasRemaining()) {
1792                        final char c = cb.get();
1793                        if (c == '%' && cb.remaining() >= 2) {
1794                                final char uc = cb.get();
1795                                final char lc = cb.get();
1796                                final int u = Character.digit(uc, RADIX);
1797                                final int l = Character.digit(lc, RADIX);
1798                                if (u != -1 && l != -1) {
1799                                        bb.put((byte) ((u << 4) + l));
1800                                }
1801                                else {
1802                                        bb.put((byte) '%');
1803                                        bb.put((byte) uc);
1804                                        bb.put((byte) lc);
1805                                }
1806                        }
1807                        else {
1808                                bb.put((byte) c);
1809                        }
1810                }
1811                bb.flip();
1812                return charset.decode(bb).toString();
1813        }
1814
1815}
